feeds.title: UNDP Eurasia Blog
feeds.description: The UNDP consults and supports the creation of data initiatives through data readiness assessments, clarification of objectives, determining target groups and ensuring responsible data practices. They revolutionize development finance, through innovation, digitalization and technology.

feeds.title: Rafael Popper's Blog
feeds.description: Rafael Popper is a British national (born in Venezuela) with over 20 years of working experience in foresight, entrepreneurship and sustainable innovation management in Europe and other world regions. He has been a principal scientist, entrepreneur, lecturer, researcher, and innovation policy consultant for various national and international organizations. He keeps track of his Foresight, Futures Studies and Innovation research, networking and knowledge transfer activities via this blog.

feeds.title: Consulta Europa
feeds.description: Consulta Europa is a SME specialised in the management of research, education and innovation projects based in the Canary Islands. Its work focuses on smart, social and sustainable development, drawing evidence from international cooperation projects. It promotes knowledge transfer with a systematic approach, considering social innovation and circular economy as essential elements, always with a gender perspective.

feeds.title: Workplace Innovation Blog
feeds.description: Workplace Innovation helps create innovative workplaces that enable people at every level of the organisation to use and develop their full range of skills, knowledge, experience and creativity. They ensure that all employees have a voice and can influence improvement and innovation through their unique employee survey. They support change leaders, managers and emerging leaders to acquire the knowledge, skills and resources needed to achieve systematic and sustainable transformation, supported by individual and in-company facilitation and coaching.

feeds.title: Research and Innovation Europa
feeds.description: Find current and upcoming funding opportunities for your research, as well as research partners, jobs and fellowships. Learn about research projects and results, joint research initiatives and EU action to promote innovation.

feeds.title: European Business & Innovation Centre Network
feeds.description: EBN (European Business and Innovation Centre Network) is a not-for-profit that serves a pan-European, global community of people that use innovative business as a driver for regional (economic) development. They are on a mission to drive sustainable, economic development and well-being in their regions.

feeds.title: i-HD Blog
feeds.description: The European Institute for Innovation through Health Data (i~HD) is a European, not-for-profit organisation facilitating the optimal uses of health data through a series of complementary activities. They strive for a world in which multiple stakeholders collaborate in the trustworthy use of high-quality health data to continuously improve care and accelerate research. They promote, develop and share good practices, tools and quality assessments to maximise community value from health data for innovations in health, care and research.

feeds.title: EUHubs4Data Blog
feeds.description: The European Federation of Data Driven Innovation Hubs aims to consolidate as the European reference for data-driven innovation and experimentation, fostering collaboration between data-driven initiatives in Europe, federating solutions in a global common catalogue of data services, and sharing data on a cross-border and cross-sector basis.

feeds.title: HORATES Innovative Training Network Blog
feeds.description: HORATES is an international doctoral programme in materials science funded by the European Union. The programme focuses on the development of organic materials suitable for converting unused waste heat into electricity.

feeds.title: Madiff Blog
feeds.description: Here you will find relevant content about the latest technology trends in the world and tips on how to improve your business growth. Madiff provides technology, resources and knowledge to deliver innovation and efficiency. Its mission is to add value to its customer's businesses by providing digital and technological innovation services, delivering disruptive results and making our clients stand out in their market.

feeds.title: Centre of Innovation for Data Tech and Artificial Intelligence (CIDAI) Blog
feeds.description: Coordinated by Eurecat, CIDAI promotes the transfer of knowledge and the realization of joint projects between knowledge-generating entities (universities, research and innovation centres), companies providing technology and services, and companies and user institutions demanding innovative applied artificial intelligence solutions. It prepares different sectoral white papers focusing on the application of Artificial Intelligence and Data Technology: in mobility, health, cultural industries, etc.
